postings.conferenceText: The SDEWES conference series is a well-established international forum on the sustainable development of energy, water and environment systems, with strong emphasis on systems thinking, sector coupling and sustainability transitions. The 21st edition, to be held in Gran Canaria, continues the conference’s interdisciplinary tradition by connecting energy engineering, environmental management, urban systems, water systems and policy analysis. The official call for papers highlights the conference as a venue for both methodological and application-oriented work, including smart energy systems, integration of renewables, storage, mobility, circular economy, industrial decarbonization, urban sustainability, and decision support for low-carbon development. Its scope makes it especially relevant to researchers working across technical, environmental and socio-economic dimensions of the energy transition. Methods, tools and approaches for sustainability; green economy, governance and just transition; smart energy systems and sector coupling; energy system analysis, planning and optimization; water-energy nexus and integrated water systems; sustainable urbanism; energy and climate policy; environmental policy and management; renewable resources and conversion technologies; district heating and cooling; biofuels and alternative fuels; electric vehicles and transport; water treatment and desalination; waste and wastewater systems; thermal and electrical storage; smart grids; hydrogen transport; buildings and industrial decarbonization; climate neutrality pathways and related special-session topics.

postings.conferenceName: 41st International Conference on Information Security and Privacy Protection 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 41st International Conference on Information Security and Privacy Protection
postings.conferenceText: IFIP SEC 2026 is the 41st edition of the IFIP TC11 conference on Information Security and Privacy Protection, one of the established international venues in the field. The conference aims to bring together researchers, practitioners, industry, and government participants to discuss current and emerging challenges in ICT security and privacy. Hosted in Perth by Edith Cowan University, SEC 2026 continues the long-running IFIP SEC series and publishes its proceedings in Springer. Theoretical and practical aspects of ICT security and privacy protection; security engineering; privacy-preserving systems; applied cryptography; identity and access management; network and systems security; socio-technical security; security management, governance, and policy; security for cloud, mobile, and critical infrastructures; security measurement, assurance, and real-world case studies.

postings.conferenceName: 22nd EAI International Conference on Security and Privacy in Communication Networks 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 22nd EAI International Conference on Security and Privacy in Communication Networks
postings.conferenceText: SecureComm 2026 is the 22nd EAI International Conference on Security and Privacy in Communication Networks. The conference focuses on cybersecurity and the security and privacy of communication and networking systems, providing a venue for both foundational research and applied results. The 2026 edition will be held in Lancaster in hybrid format and continues the SecureComm series as a forum for researchers and practitioners working on secure communications and trustworthy networked systems. Security and privacy in communication networks; secure networking protocols; wireless, mobile, and IoT security; network defense and attack analysis; applied cryptography for communications; authentication and authorization; privacy-preserving communications; systems and platform security; cyber threat detection and response; security for emerging networked and distributed environments.

postings.conferenceName: 18th International Conference on Sustainable Energy & Environmental Protection 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 18th International Conference on Sustainable Energy & Environmental Protection
postings.conferenceText: The Sustainable Energy & Environmental Protection (SEEP) conference series is an established international forum dedicated to clean energy, environmental protection and sustainable development. The 18th edition is hosted by the University of Rome Tor Vergata and continues SEEP’s role in bringing together academic researchers, industry professionals and policy-oriented participants who work on energy technologies, environmental sustainability and low-carbon solutions. The official website presents the conference as a place for presenting peer-reviewed research, networking and interdisciplinary discussion, with keynote talks, technical sessions and proceedings publication. SEEP is particularly relevant for work that connects engineering solutions with environmental performance and sustainability outcomes. Sustainable energy technologies; environmental protection and sustainability; renewable energy systems; low-carbon engineering solutions; interactions between energy, environment and policy; conference papers, keynote themes and technical-session topics related to clean energy and environmental improvement as reflected on the official conference site.

postings.conferenceName: 22nd International Conference on Sustainable Energy Technologies 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 22nd International Conference on Sustainable Energy Technologies
postings.conferenceText: The 22nd International Conference on Sustainable Energy Technologies (SET2026) is a long-running conference series dedicated to practical and research-driven solutions for sustainable energy and the built environment. According to the official website, the series has been held annually since 2002 and has developed into an international platform for engineers, scientists and policy-oriented participants working on renewable energy, energy efficiency, low-carbon buildings, urban sustainability and environmental stewardship. The 2026 edition is being organized in Kuala Lumpur and continues this tradition by focusing on technologies and strategies that support sustainable development, decarbonization and implementation of cleaner energy systems in real-world contexts. AI-enhanced energy technologies and renewable systems; energy storage and conversion; low-carbon building design and sustainable architectural practices; sustainable urban development, environmental stewardship and city planning; policies and management in sustainable energy; broader sustainable energy technology research, implementation and management issues reflected in the official conference themes.

postings.conferenceName: SETAC Europe 36th Annual Meeting 2026
postings.conferenceText: The SETAC Europe 36th Annual Meeting is a major international conference for environmental toxicology, chemistry, exposure science, risk assessment, life cycle thinking, and environmental policy. The 2026 meeting in Maastricht is organized around the theme “Embrace the outlier. In science, regulations and networks,” underscoring the role of novel findings, interdisciplinary thinking, and collaboration in addressing environmental challenges. SETAC’s annual meetings are widely used by researchers, regulators, consultants, industry scientists, and public-sector specialists to present new research, discuss regulatory science, and connect fundamental environmental studies with real-world decision-making. The official programme structure shows a broad environmental focus spanning chemical fate and exposure, toxicological effects, ecological protection, human health, life cycle approaches, policy, management, and cross-cutting emerging topics. Environmental and human toxicology in changing climates; omics, biomarkers and novel methods in ecotoxicology; stress ecology and multiple stressors; environmental chemistry and exposure assessment; monitoring, modelling and chemical fate; ecological and human health risk assessment; life cycle assessment, life cycle management and footprinting; environmental policy, risk management and science communication; cross-cutting, emerging, transdisciplinary and outlying topics in environmental science and regulation.

postings.conferenceName: The 11th International Symposium on Dependable Software Engineering: Theories, Tools and Applications 2025
postings.conferenceSeries: The 11th International Symposium on Dependable Software Engineering: Theories, Tools and Applications
postings.conferenceText: SETTA is an international symposium on dependable software engineering, bringing together work on theories, tools, and applications for building trustworthy software systems. The 2025 meeting at the University of Oxford marks the 11th edition of the series and serves as a forum for researchers interested in rigor, reliability, and formal engineering approaches. Although the homepage is concise, the series positioning clearly emphasizes dependable software engineering across methods, tools, and applications. Dependable software engineering; theories, tools, and applications for trustworthy software; formal reasoning, verification, analysis, and dependable system development.

postings.conferenceName: Symposium on Geometry Processing 2026 2026
postings.conferenceText: SGP 2026 is the Symposium on Geometry Processing 2026, a leading venue for new research on the computational treatment of geometric data. The symposium brings together work on the mathematical, algorithmic, and practical foundations of geometry processing, linking computer graphics, geometric modeling, vision, fabrication, and related areas. The 2026 edition in Bern continues the series’ role as a core meeting point for geometry-focused research and applications. Geometry processing; geometric modeling and shape analysis; meshes, point clouds and implicit representations; parameterization and remeshing; deformation, editing and simulation of geometry; geometric deep learning; reconstruction and acquisition; geometry for fabrication and digital manufacturing; geometry in graphics, vision and scientific computing.

postings.conferenceName: ACM SIGCOMM 2026 2026
postings.conferenceText: ACM SIGCOMM 2026 is the flagship annual conference of ACM SIGCOMM and one of the most important venues in data communication and networking. The conference seeks significant research contributions and significant deployment experiences in communication networks and networked systems, and the 2026 edition is held at the Colorado Convention Center in Denver, Colorado. The conference accepts both research and experience papers and continues SIGCOMM's role as a premier forum for networking research. According to the official call for papers, SIGCOMM takes a broad view of networking, including all types of computer networks (mobile, wide-area, datacenter, embedded, home, and enterprise), all wired and wireless technologies (optics, radio, acoustic, visible-light communication), and all aspects of networked systems such as architecture, packet- and circuit-switched hardware and software, virtualization, mobility, resource management, performance, energy and environmental impact, topology, robustness, security, diagnosis, verification, privacy, economics, evolution, and interactions with applications. It also welcomes all parts of the network lifecycle and all approaches including theory, analysis, experimentation, and AI/machine learning for networking.

postings.conferenceName: SIGGRAPH 2026: The 53rd International Conference & Exhibition on Computer Graphics & Interactive Techniques 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: SIGGRAPH 2026: The 53rd International Conference & Exhibition on Computer Graphics & Interactive Techniques
postings.conferenceText: SIGGRAPH 2026 is the 53rd International Conference and Exhibition on Computer Graphics and Interactive Techniques, the premier global event for computer graphics, interactive techniques, and adjacent creative and technical fields. The conference and exhibition bring together researchers, artists, developers, designers, and production professionals working across graphics, animation, games, immersive media, and new digital experiences. The 2026 event takes place in Los Angeles, California. The official site organizes the conference around broad areas such as Production and Animation, Research and Education, Arts and Design, Gaming and Interactive, and New Technologies. Submission-related content also references multiple contribution formats and tracks, including posters, real-time presentations, frontiers content, student research, and other graphics and interactive-technique activities.

postings.conferenceName: ACM SIGMETRICS 2026 2026
postings.conferenceText: SIGMETRICS 2026 is the flagship conference of the ACM special interest group for the computer systems performance evaluation community. The conference brings together researchers interested in modeling, measurement, analysis, and evaluation of computer systems and networks. The 2026 edition will be held at the University of Michigan in Ann Arbor and continues SIGMETRICS’s role as a central venue for rigorous systems performance research. Computer systems performance evaluation; modeling and measurement; analytical and empirical evaluation of systems and networks; methodologies and tools for understanding performance, scalability, and efficiency of modern computing systems.

postings.conferenceName: ACM SIGMOD/PODS International Conference on Management of Data 2027
postings.conferenceSeries: ACM SIGMOD/PODS International Conference on Management of Data
postings.conferenceText: SIGMOD 2027 is the ACM SIGMOD/PODS International Conference on Management of Data, one of the flagship conferences in data management. The conference brings together the database systems, data analytics, and theory communities and covers both foundational advances and systems innovations. The 2027 edition in Huntington Beach continues the series’ central role in presenting new ideas in data management architectures, algorithms, and applications at scale. Database systems and architectures; query processing and optimization; transaction processing and concurrency control; data integration and data cleaning; graph, stream and spatial data management; large-scale analytics; cloud and distributed data systems; ML/AI for data management and data management for AI workloads; data privacy, security and responsible data systems.

postings.conferenceName: 34th ACM SIGSPATIAL International Conference on Advances in Geographic Information Systems 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 34th ACM SIGSPATIAL International Conference on Advances in Geographic Information Systems
postings.conferenceText: ACM SIGSPATIAL 2026 is the 34th ACM SIGSPATIAL International Conference on Advances in Geographic Information Systems. The conference is a major venue for geographic information science, spatial data management, and geo-enabled applications, bringing together database, systems, analytics, and geospatial communities. The 2026 edition in Riverside continues the conference’s focus on theory, algorithms, systems, and applications involving spatial, spatio-temporal, and mobility data. Geographic information systems; spatial and spatio-temporal data management; geospatial analytics and mining; mobility data and trajectory analysis; location-based services; maps, spatial indexing and query processing; geospatial machine learning; remote sensing and urban analytics; privacy, ethics and fairness for geospatial data systems.

postings.conferenceName: 2026 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 2026 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics
postings.conferenceText: IEEE SMC 2026 is the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics, the flagship annual meeting of the IEEE SMC Society. The conference provides a broad interdisciplinary platform spanning systems science and engineering, human-machine systems, and cybernetics. The 2026 edition in Bellevue highlights both foundational methods and application-driven work in intelligent systems, human-centered technologies, robotics, autonomy, and secure cyber-physical environments, with in-person participation strongly encouraged while also accommodating online presentation where necessary. Systems science and engineering; human-machine interaction; cybernetics and intelligent systems; artificial intelligence and machine learning; robotics and autonomous systems; cyber-physical systems; decision and control systems; computational intelligence; smart infrastructure and transportation; healthcare and assistive systems; cybersecurity and resilient systems.

postings.conferenceName: Shape Modeling International 2025
postings.conferenceText: SMI is an international forum for new mathematical theories and computational techniques for modeling, simulating, and processing digital representations of shapes and their properties. The 2025 event is co-located with SPM in Hangzhou and continues SMI’s role in linking researchers, developers, students, and practitioners across geometry processing, modeling, and application areas. The conference welcomes original work in shape modeling and applications, and emphasizes reproducibility through participation in the Replicability Stamp Initiative. AR/VR environments; acquisition and reconstruction; behavior and animation models; compression and streaming; computational topology; correspondence and registration; curves and surfaces; digital fabrication and 3D printing; geometric deep learning; shape collections, feature extraction and classification; healing and resampling; implicit surfaces; interactive modeling, design, and editing; learning techniques for shape modeling; medial and skeletal representations; parametric and procedural models; segmentation; semantics; shape analysis and synthesis; applications in design, biomedicine, GIS, geoscience, art, cultural heritage, gaming, and education; shape statistics; deformation; simulation; 3D retrieval and digital twins.

postings.conferenceName: ACM Symposium on Cloud Computing 2026 2026
postings.conferenceText: SoCC 2026 is the ACM Symposium on Cloud Computing, a premier research conference dedicated to cloud computing systems, data infrastructure, and large-scale services. As the only conference co-sponsored by ACM SIGMOD and SIGOPS, the series sits at the intersection of data management and systems, bringing together work on the design, implementation, evaluation, and operation of cloud platforms and cloud-native applications. The 2026 edition takes place in Singapore as an in-person event. The symposium covers cloud platforms, datacenter systems, storage and data services, distributed execution, resource management, multi-tenant infrastructure, serverless and cloud-native systems, reliability and observability, security and privacy in the cloud, performance engineering, AI/ML workloads in cloud environments, and practical experience reports on cloud systems and services. The 2026 call uses two submission rounds; this record lists the first-round abstract and paper deadlines.

postings.conferenceName: 42nd International Symposium on Computational Geometry 2026
postings.conferenceText: SoCG, the International Symposium on Computational Geometry, is the anchor event of CG Week and the premier international forum for advances in computational geometry and its applications. The 2026 meeting is held at Rutgers University in New Brunswick as part of CG Week, which also includes media, young researcher, challenge, and workshop events. The conference highlights both theoretical and practical aspects of geometry and topology, and the 2026 call explicitly encourages work on implementation, engineering, experimentation, and applications alongside core algorithmic and mathematical contributions. Computational geometry and topology; geometry, topology, algorithms, and applications; practical aspects including implementation, engineering, experimentation, and applications; lightweight double-blind submissions; formal proceedings versions plus reproducibility expectations; associated CG Week workshops and community events.

postings.conferenceName: ACM-SIAM Symposium on Discrete Algorithms 2027
postings.conferenceText: SODA 2027 is the ACM-SIAM Symposium on Discrete Algorithms, a premier venue for research on the design, analysis, and applications of discrete algorithms. The symposium is a central meeting point for the algorithms community and regularly features contributions spanning theory, optimization, graph algorithms, randomized methods, and algorithmic applications. The 2027 edition is scheduled as an in-person event in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. The symposium covers discrete algorithms broadly, including algorithm design and analysis, combinatorial optimization, graph algorithms, approximation, randomized algorithms, online and streaming computation, algorithmic game theory, data structures, and theoretical advances with practical algorithmic impact.

postings.conferenceName: 32nd SolarPACES Conference 2026
postings.conferenceText: SolarPACES 2026 is the 32nd edition of the long-running SolarPACES conference series, an international forum focused on concentrating solar thermal technologies and related thermal and solar-chemical energy systems. The official conference announcement describes a broad technical scope that spans research, engineering development, industrial deployment and market integration. The meeting brings together researchers, plant developers, manufacturers, operators, and policy-oriented participants working on solar thermal power generation, storage, hybrid systems, process heat and emerging solar fuel applications. As a specialized series with a strong international community, SolarPACES plays an important role in advancing engineering solutions for dispatchable solar energy and high-temperature renewable heat. Concentrating solar thermal power and power cycles; collectors, receivers and thermal systems; thermal energy storage; operations and maintenance; simulation, modelling and digital tools including AI; hybrid systems and grid integration; solar process heat and desalination; market development, policy and commercial projects; solar resource assessment and measurement systems; advanced materials and coatings; solar fuels, solar chemistry and high-temperature thermochemical processes.

postings.conferenceName: 32nd Symposium on Operating Systems Principles 2026
postings.conferenceText: SOSP 2026 is the 32nd Symposium on Operating Systems Principles, one of the world’s premier forums for computer systems technology. The conference highlights significant advances in operating systems and closely related areas of systems research, often shaping the future of the field. The Prague edition continues SOSP’s tradition of presenting influential work on the principles, abstractions, and implementation of modern computing systems. Operating systems principles; distributed systems; storage and file systems; systems for cloud, networking, and data-intensive workloads; performance and scalability; reliability and fault tolerance; security and privacy in systems; innovative systems abstractions and implementation techniques.

postings.conferenceName: Symposium on Usable Privacy and Security 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: Symposium on Usable Privacy and Security
postings.conferenceText: SOUPS 2026 is the Symposium on Usable Privacy and Security, a major venue for research at the intersection of security, privacy, and human-centered computing. The conference emphasizes the design, evaluation, and deployment of systems that are secure and privacy-preserving while remaining understandable and usable by real people. SOUPS brings together researchers and practitioners studying human behavior, interfaces, policy, and technical mechanisms related to usable privacy and security. Usable security and privacy; human-centered security design; authentication and identity usability; privacy notices, consent, and disclosure; user mental models of security; behavior, risk perception, and decision making; safety for at-risk populations; socio-technical studies of privacy and security; measurement and evaluation of user-facing privacy and security tools.

postings.conferenceName: 38th ACM Symposium on Parallelism in Algorithms and Architectures 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 38th ACM Symposium on Parallelism in Algorithms and Architectures
postings.conferenceText: SPAA 2026 is the 38th ACM Symposium on Parallelism in Algorithms and Architectures, a major venue for parallel and distributed computation. The symposium brings together research on the theory, design, and implementation of parallel algorithms and the architectures that support them. The 2026 edition will be held in London, co-located with related events, and continues SPAA’s role in connecting algorithmic advances with system and architectural considerations. Parallel algorithms; concurrent and distributed computation; architectures for parallelism; theory and practice of scalable computation; algorithmic and architectural approaches to efficient parallel systems.

postings.conferenceName: 28th International Conference on Speech and Computer 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 28th International Conference on Speech and Computer
postings.conferenceText: SPECOM 2026 is the 28th International Conference on Speech and Computer and marks 30 years since the first SPECOM in 1996. The conference brings together researchers, linguists, and engineers working across speech science, speech and language technologies, human-computer interaction, forensics, voice disorders, and paralinguistics. The official website presents SPECOM as a long-running international forum with prior editions held in cities across Europe and Asia, and the 2026 edition continues this tradition in Ohrid, North Macedonia. The event emphasizes both foundational and applied research in speech and language science and positions itself at the intersection of systems, signals, and intelligent technologies. Accepted papers are to be published by Springer Nature in the LNCS/LNAI series, and the site notes that presenting authors may opt in for online presentation, while the main venue is Hotel Granit on Lake Ohrid. Speech and language processing; multimodal, interactive and embodied AI; paralinguistics, behavior and affective computing; deployment, trust and healthcare; speech science; speech and language technologies; human-computer interaction; forensics; voice disorders; intelligent technologies. The official site describes SPECOM as a venue for research in speech and computer-related disciplines and highlights four main topical clusters on the homepage: Speech & Language Processing; Multimodal, Interactive & Embodied AI; Paralinguistics, Behavior & Affective Computing; and Deployment, Trust & Healthcare. Papers are submitted electronically via EasyChair and accepted papers are published in Springer Nature’s LNCS/LNAI series.

postings.conferenceName: Symposium on Solid and Physical Modeling 2025
postings.conferenceSeries: Symposium on Solid and Physical Modeling
postings.conferenceText: SPM is an international conference series organized with the support of the Solid Modeling Association. The 2025 symposium is co-located with SMI in Hangzhou and focuses on all aspects of geometric and physical modeling, together with applications in design, analysis, manufacturing, biomedical and geophysical domains, digital entertainment, and beyond. The conference also serves as the venue for the 2025 Pierre Bézier Prize ceremony, reinforcing its role in the solid and physical modeling community. Solid and physical modeling; geometric and physical modeling; applications in design, analysis, manufacturing, biomedical and geophysical domains, digital entertainment, and related areas.

postings.conferenceName: 58th ACM Symposium on Theory of Computing 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 58th ACM Symposium on Theory of Computing
postings.conferenceText: STOC 2026 is the 58th ACM Symposium on Theory of Computing, one of the flagship conferences in theoretical computer science. Sponsored by ACM SIGACT, the conference is a premier venue for foundational advances in algorithms, complexity, randomness, combinatorics, optimization, learning theory, cryptography, and related areas. The 2026 edition is held in Salt Lake City, Utah as part of a broader TheoryFest program with papers, posters, invited talks, tutorials, and workshops. Typical topics listed on the conference site include algorithms and data structures, computational complexity, randomness in computing, algorithmic graph theory and combinatorics, analysis of Boolean functions, approximation algorithms, cryptography, computational learning theory, continuous and discrete optimization, economics and computation, parallel and distributed algorithms, quantum computing, algorithmic coding theory, computational geometry and topology, computational logic, algebraic computation, and theoretical aspects of machine learning, fairness, privacy, networks, data management, databases, and computational biology.

postings.conferenceName: 23rd Theory of Cryptography Conference 2025
postings.conferenceText: TCC 2025 is the 23rd Theory of Cryptography Conference, one of the central venues for foundational cryptography research. Organized under the IACR, TCC emphasizes the conceptual and mathematical underpinnings of cryptographic systems, protocols, and security notions. The conference serves as a forum for results on both established and emerging areas of theoretical cryptography. Foundations of cryptography; secure computation; zero-knowledge and proof systems; hardness assumptions; pseudorandomness; encryption and signatures; cryptographic protocols; information-theoretic and computational security; quantum and post-quantum theory; rigorous analysis of cryptographic constructions and models.

postings.conferenceName: TMS 2026 Annual Meeting & Exhibition 2026
postings.conferenceText: TMS 2026 Annual Meeting & Exhibition is the annual flagship event of The Minerals, Metals & Materials Society and a major international forum for researchers and professionals across minerals, metals, and materials. The 2026 edition will take place in San Diego, California and is positioned as a large-scale meeting that convenes thousands of attendees from academia, national laboratories, and industry. The event is organized through a broad set of technical symposia and programming tracks spanning structural materials, functional materials, extraction and processing, manufacturing, modeling, energy-related materials, and professional practice. Its scope makes it a key venue for developments in metallurgy, materials engineering, manufacturing, and related applications. Minerals, metals and materials research; extraction and processing; structural and functional materials; light metals and alloys; additive manufacturing and processing technologies; computational materials engineering and modeling; characterization and performance; energy materials; recycling and sustainability; manufacturing innovation; and broad professional and technical symposia presented under the TMS annual meeting program.

postings.conferenceName: Traditional Med 2027
postings.conferenceSeries: 10th Edition of International Conference on Traditional Medicine and Integrative Health
postings.conferenceText: The 10th Edition of International Conference on Traditional Medicine and Integrative Health bridges traditional medicine and modern healthcare in Rome and Online from June 24-26, 2027, with sixteen tracks over three days. Coordinated by Magnus Group LLC, the meeting draws scholars, cultural practitioners, herbal-medicine experts, and clinical professionals into shared conversation. Sessions extend across Traditional Chinese Medicine, Ayurveda, acupuncture, herbal medicine, and mind-body therapies within a focused three-day programme. Organised as a CPD-accredited three-day meeting at NH Villa Carpegna, Rome (June 24-26, 2027), the 10th Edition of International Conference on Traditional Medicine and Integrative Health (Traditional Med 2027) gives the international traditional-medicine and integrative-health community a working forum for scholarly briefings, cultural-medicine sessions, and case-based discussion. Every part of the programme is directed at bringing traditional knowledge and clinical evidence together in ways that benefit scholars, practitioners, and public-health professionals. Coverage at this Holistic Medicine Conference 2027 reaches across Traditional Chinese Medicine, Ayurveda, acupuncture, herbal medicine, phytotherapy, mind-body therapies, yoga and meditation, aromatherapy and music therapy, biofeedback mechanisms, natural therapies, holistic treatment, cultural preservation in medicine, modern-healthcare integration, and global-health integration. Delegates and presenters at the conference are issued a CPD certificate of attendance; oral or poster abstracts that pass review add further academic recognition. Within the Traditional Medicine Conferences 2027 calendar, this meeting operates a tiered registration model - abstract submission for speakers and presenters, standard or early-bird rates for delegates and listeners. postings.conferenceName: 23rd International Workshop on Trust, Privacy and Security in the Digital Society 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 23rd International Workshop on Trust, Privacy and Security in the Digital Society
postings.conferenceText: TrustBus 2026 is the 23rd International Workshop on Trust, Privacy and Security in the Digital Society and will be held in conjunction with ARES 2026. The official workshop page describes TrustBus as a long-running international and interdisciplinary forum, with a series dating back to 2004, where researchers and practitioners exchange advances in the state of the art and practice of trust, privacy, and security. The 2026 edition frames its scope in the context of a rapidly evolving digital society shaped by generative AI, cloud and edge computing, and the Internet of Things. The workshop emphasizes both technical innovation and the broader societal, legal, and regulatory environment in which digital trust and security challenges arise. As a co-located workshop within ARES, it sits at the intersection of dependable systems, privacy protection, and secure digital services. Accountability, transparency and intervenability; anonymity and pseudonymity; common practices, legal and regulatory issues; detecting and preventing digital misinformation; economics of cyber security and privacy; identity management, identity theft and trust management; information audit and trust; reliable auction, e-procurement and negotiation technology; security and privacy for cloud and edge computing; security and privacy in data governance and management; security and privacy patterns and antipatterns; security, privacy and trust for digital society services; security, privacy and trust in mobile environments; supply chain cyber security; trust and reputation for digital societies; trustworthy AI; usability of security and privacy technologies and services.

postings.conferenceName: 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence
postings.conferenceText: UAI 2026 is the 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence, a premier conference devoted to knowledge representation, learning, and reasoning under uncertainty. Since 1985, the series has brought together the community working on probabilistic reasoning, causal inference, structured models, decision making, and statistically grounded AI methods. The 2026 edition takes place in Amsterdam, Netherlands, with tutorials and workshops surrounding the main conference. The conference focuses on uncertainty in artificial intelligence, including probabilistic modeling, Bayesian methods, causal reasoning, decision making, inference and learning under uncertainty, structured representations, and related theoretical and application-driven advances.

postings.conferenceName: UbiComp / ISWC 2026 2026
postings.conferenceText: UbiComp / ISWC 2026 is the joint conference for ubiquitous computing and wearable computing, bringing together the communities behind two influential ACM conference series. The event covers the design, implementation, and study of technologies embedded in everyday environments, devices, and interactions, from pervasive sensing to human-centered wearable systems. The 2026 edition in Shanghai continues the joint conference’s role as a hub for innovative, interdisciplinary work spanning systems, interaction, health, intelligence, and real-world deployment. Ubiquitous and pervasive computing; wearable computing and sensing; mobile and context-aware systems; IoT and smart environments; human-centered AI in everyday settings; health, wellbeing and assistive technologies; privacy, ethics and trust in ubiquitous systems; interaction techniques and user studies; real-world deployments and longitudinal evaluations.

postings.conferenceName: ACM Symposium on User Interface Software and Technology 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: ACM Symposium on User Interface Software and Technology
postings.conferenceText: UIST 2026 is the ACM Symposium on User Interface Software and Technology, a premier forum for innovations in human-computer interfaces. The symposium showcases advances in the software and hardware of interactive systems, including novel interaction techniques, input/output technologies, toolkits, and applied interface systems. The 2026 edition in Detroit continues UIST’s strong tradition of presenting influential, forward-looking work on interactive technologies. User interface software and technology; innovative interaction techniques; hardware and sensing for interfaces; toolkits and systems for interactive computing; novel input/output methods; prototyping, design, and evaluation of next-generation interactive technologies.

postings.conferenceName: 61st International Universities Power Engineering Conference 2026
postings.conferenceText: The 61st International Universities Power Engineering Conference (UPEC 2026) is a long-running international forum on electric power engineering hosted by the University of Cagliari. The 2026 conference is framed around the theme “Bridging Power Engineering Heritage and the AI-Driven Energy Future,” positioning the event as a venue for both classical and emerging topics in modern power systems. UPEC traditionally gathers researchers, academics, students, and industry participants working across power generation, transmission, distribution, power electronics, system operation, and digital energy technologies. The conference particularly emphasizes the interaction between established power engineering methods and newer developments such as artificial intelligence, data-driven operation, flexible energy systems, and resilient pathways toward a carbon-neutral energy future. Artificial intelligence in power system operation; planning, control and forecasting; intelligent management of grids and distributed energy resources; resilience, flexibility and sustainability of energy systems; conventional and renewable power engineering; smart grids; power electronics; system analysis, operation and optimization; future low-carbon electricity infrastructures and AI-enabled energy technologies.

postings.conferenceName: 36th USENIX Security Symposium 2027
postings.conferenceText: The 36th USENIX Security Symposium is a flagship venue for advances in the security and privacy of computer systems and networks. The symposium brings together research on attacks, defenses, secure systems design, privacy technologies, and the empirical study of security in practice. The 2027 edition is scheduled in Denver, Colorado and continues the USENIX Security tradition as one of the most influential conferences in computer security. The symposium broadly covers systems and network security, privacy, applied cryptography, software and hardware security, web and mobile security, secure machine learning, measurement studies, usable security, offensive and defensive techniques, and practical evaluations of security and privacy technologies. The homepage lists two submission cycles; this record captures cycle 1.

postings.conferenceName: 53rd International Conference on Very Large Data Bases 2027
postings.conferenceSeries: 53rd International Conference on Very Large Data Bases
postings.conferenceText: VLDB 2027 is the 53rd International Conference on Very Large Data Bases, one of the flagship conferences in data management. The conference advances the state of the art in data systems, data-intensive applications, and large-scale information processing, and has a long history of publishing influential work at the intersection of theory, systems, and practice. The 2027 edition in Athens continues VLDB’s role as a major international venue for innovations in modern data infrastructure. Database systems; data processing at scale; query optimization and execution; cloud and distributed data management; graph, streaming and spatial data; analytics and data science systems; data management for machine learning and AI; transaction processing and consistency; data integration and information quality; privacy, security and responsible data systems.

postings.conferenceName: The 10th International Symposium on Flash Floods in Wadi Systems
postings.conferenceText: Topics: wadi ecosystems and environmental connectivity 3d hydrological connectivity of wadis. nature based solutions in wadi climate change impactsThe 10th International Symposium on Flash Floods in Wadi Systems (ISFF-2027)March 29-31, 2027, Kyoto-Japan Main Theme: Wadi Ecosystems and Environmental Connectivity 1. Introduction Since its inception in 2015, the International Symposium on Flash Floods (ISFF) has evolved into a globally recognized platform for advancing research, innovation, and collaboration in flash flood risk management. The first symposium, held in Wadi (October 2015), laid the foundation for a dynamic international network of researchers, engineers, and practitioners dedicated to understanding and mitigating flash flood hazards. Over the past decade, ISFF has expanded across diverse geographical and climatic contexts, reflecting the global nature of flash flood challenges. From El-Gouna, Egypt (2016) and GUtech, Oman (2017), to Casablanca, Morocco (2018), the symposium strengthened its scientific and regional engagement. Returning to Kyoto, Japan, in 2020 marked a significant milestone, reinforcing the role of advanced research institutions in shaping innovative solutions. Despite global challenges, ISFF continued to grow, with subsequent editions in Amman, Jordan (2021), Tlemcen, Algeria (2023), Al-Ain, UAE (2024), and Muscat, Oman (2025). Each event contributed to building a robust interdisciplinary community, integrating hydrology, climate science, engineering, and emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence and digital twins.The 10th ISFF, to be held in Kyoto, Japan (March 2027), represents a landmark return to its academic roots at Kyoto University’s Disaster Prevention Research Institute (DPRI). This edition celebrates a decade of progress while setting a forward-looking agenda focused on AI-driven flood forecasting, real-time monitoring, climate resilience, and sustainable risk governance. Bringing together global experts, policymakers, and young researchers, ISFF 2027 aims to strengthen international collaboration and accelerate the transition from research to real-world impact. As flash flood risks intensify under climate change, the symposium reaffirms its mission: to advance science, foster innovation, and support communities worldwide in building resilience against one of the most destructive natural hazards.2. Scope The ecological health of these Wadi systems relies on a delicate balance of surface flows, subsurface pathways, groundwater recharge, sediment movement, and coastal interactions.The 10th International Symposium on Flash Floods (ISFF) will bring together global experts to explore how we can understand the hydrological and ecological connectivity in Wadi environments from upstream headwaters to downstream coastal zones. 3. Key dates 4. Why Wadi Ecosystems and Environmental Connectivity?Flash floods are not only hydrological events, but they are also deeply interconnected with the structure, function, and health of wadi ecosystems. Wadis, as ephemeral river systems dominant in arid and semi-arid regions, play a critical role in linking hydrology, geomorphology, ecology, and human systems. However, traditional flash flood studies have often focused primarily on hydraulic processes, overlooking these vital environmental connections.The selection of “Wadi Ecosystems and Environmental Connectivity” as the central theme of the 10th ISFF reflects a necessary shift toward integrated and system-based understanding. Flash floods in wadis influence sediment transport, groundwater recharge, vegetation dynamics, and habitat connectivity. At the same time, changes in land use, urbanization, and climate variability disrupt these natural linkages, often amplifying flood risks and ecological degradation.This theme emphasizes the importance of:Hydro-ecological connectivity: understanding how water flow links surface water, groundwater, and ecosystemsSediment and nutrient pathways: capturing the role of floods in shaping landscapes and sustaining biodiversityEcosystem-based risk reduction: leveraging natural systems (e.g., vegetation, floodplains) to mitigate hazardsHuman–environment interactions: addressing how infrastructure, urban expansion, and policy decisions alter wadi behaviorIn the context of accelerating climate change, extreme rainfall events are becoming more frequent and intense, particularly in dryland regions. This increases the urgency to move beyond isolated flood modeling toward holistic frameworks that integrate environmental processes, ecological resilience, and advanced technologies such as AI and Digital Twins. By focusing on environmental connectivity, ISFF 2027 aims to bridge disciplines, enabling a new generation of solutions that are not only technically robust but also environmentally sustainable and socially adaptive. This approach aligns with global priorities in climate resilience, nature-based solutions, and sustainable water resource management. Ultimately, this theme reflects a core message:Understanding and restoring connectivity within wadi systems is essential for reducing flash flood risks and ensuring long-term resilience in vulnerable regions. 5. postings.conferenceName: The 12th International Conference on Business and Finance - “Leading through Disruption: The New Global Economic Order”
postings.conferenceText: Topics: sustainability logistics supply chain management finance digital transformationThe 12th International Conference on Business & Finance 2026 will advance the conference's established industry-academia platform by focusing on one of the most urgent questions facing governments, organizations, investors, and universities today: how to lead effectively through disruption. Under the theme "Leading through Disruption: The New Global Economic Order," the conference will examine the profound shifts reshaping global business, including geopolitical uncertainty, economic fragmentation, inflationary pressures, rapid digitalization, artificial intelligence, climate risk, supply chain instability, and changing workforce expectations.Hosted by Effat College of Business, ICBF2026 invites contributions that bridge academia and industry and advance rigorous, relevant, and impactful research. The two-day conference will include an opening keynote, plenary and industry panels, a student business exhibition, parallel industry workshops, a PhD workshop, academic paper sessions, and closing reflections.Submission GuidelinesSubmissions to ICBF2026 must be original, unpublished research papers written in English, with a maximum length of 8,000 words. All papers will be subject to a blind peer-review process to ensure academic rigor and relevance to the conference theme. High quality papers will be considered for publication in partner journals and book series.List of TopicsThe 12th International Conference on Business and Finance (ICBF2026) include the following tracks:Track 1: Leadership and strategic decision-making under uncertaintyThis track explores how leaders design and execute strategy in highly volatile, complex, and ambiguous environments marked by economic, technological, and geopolitical shocks. It welcomes contributions on adaptive leadership, scenario planning, governance, and decision-making frameworks that enable organizations to navigate disruption while sustaining performance and legitimacy.Track 2: Geopolitics, trade fragmentation, and the new global economic orderThis track examines how shifting power structures, trade blocs, sanctions, and regional alliances are reshaping global value chains and capital flows. It invites research on policy responses, corporate strategies, and institutional arrangements that help firms and countries reposition themselves within an increasingly fragmented global economic order.Track 3: Saudi Arabia’s role in Vision 2030, economic diversification, and global competitivenessThis track examines Saudi Arabia’s Vision 2030 reforms, their impact on economic diversification, and the Kingdom’s evolving position in global markets and investment flows. It welcomes papers on policy design, sectoral transformation, public-private partnerships, and regional integration that showcase Saudi Arabia as a hub for innovation, sustainable growth, and international collaboration.Track 4: Artificial intelligence, digital transformation, data governance, and cybersecurityThis track explores the strategic and operational implications of AI, data analytics, and digital platforms for business models, financial services, and public policy. It seeks contributions on responsible AI, data governance, privacy, and cybersecurity, highlighting how organizations can leverage digital transformation while mitigating emerging technological and ethical risks.Track 5: Resilient supply chains, logistics transformation, and operational continuityThis track investigates how organizations design resilient, technology-enabled supply chains capable of withstanding geopolitical tensions, climate shocks, and demand disruptions. It welcomes work on logistics innovation, reshoring and nearshoring strategies, risk mapping, and business continuity planning that sustain service levels and competitiveness during crises.Track 6: Entrepreneurship, innovation ecosystems, and new business modelsThis track examines how entrepreneurs and innovation ecosystems respond to disruption through new ventures, platform models, and collaborative networks. It invites papers on startup financing, incubators and accelerators, university-industry linkages, and novel business models that drive inclusive growth and resilience in turbulent environments.Track 7: ESG, sustainability, climate risk, and responsible businessThis track focuses on how environmental, social, and governance (ESG) imperatives are transforming corporate strategy, investment decisions, and regulatory agendas. It welcomes research on sustainable finance, climate risk management, impact measurement, and responsible business practices that align profitability with long-term societal and planetary well-being.Track 8: Human capital, future of work, talent mobility, and leadership capabilitiesThis track explores how disruption is reshaping workforce structures, skills, and leadership competencies across sectors and regions. It invites contributions on talent development, remote and hybrid work models, global mobility, and inclusive leadership practices that build agile, high-performing organizations in the new world of work.Track 9: Financial resilience, capital markets, investment, and risk managementThis track focuses on how firms, financial institutions, and regulators build resilience in the face of market volatility, systemic risk, and evolving investor behavior. It welcomes studies on capital markets dynamics, portfolio and risk management, fintech innovations, and regulatory frameworks that support stable yet competitive financial systems.VenueThe conference will be held in Effat University, Jeddah - Saudi Arabia ContactAll questions about submissions should be emailed to icbf@effatuniversity.edu.sasarelzarka@effatuniversity.edu.sa

postings.conferenceName: XIX Seminario Internacional de Investigación sobre Globalización y Territorio (RII)
postings.conferenceText: Topics: urban and regional studies urban and regional inequalities geopolitics and geoeconomics globalization and territorial transformationsCONVOCATÓRIAO XIX Seminário Internacional da Rede Ibero-Americana de Investigação sobre Globalização e Território (RII) é realizado em homenagem ao Professor Carlos A. de Mattos, Presidente Honorário do Comitê Científico da Rede e um de seus fundadores.A Rede Ibero-Americana de Investigação sobre Globalização e Território (RII) e o Programa de Pós-Graduação em Políticas Públicas da Universidade Federal do Paraná, em colaboração com a Universidade Autônoma do Estado do México, convidam pesquisadores, professores e alunos de graduação e pós-graduação a submeterem trabalhos para participar do XIX Seminário RII: Transformações produtivas e tensões geopolíticas: desafios para os povos ibero-americanos.Curitiba, Paraná, Brasil, 7 a 9 de outubro de 2026Modalidade: presencialAntecedentesA Rede Ibero-Americana de Investigação sobre Globalização e Território (RII) foi criada em 1994 durante um seminário realizado em Pereira, Colômbia, com o objetivo de gerar um espaço para análise e debate sobre os processos de reestruturação econômica, produtiva, social, política e institucional em diferentes escalas territoriais nos países ibero-americanos.Desde a sua criação, a RII tem abordado temas como a reorganização territorial das atividades econômicas e da população, as desigualdades regionais e locais em termos de bem-estar social, a difusão de inovações tecnológicas e as transformações na gestão pública territorial, num contexto marcado pela globalização e pelas mudanças tecnológicas.Ao longo de sua história, o RII organizou dezoito seminários em diversas cidades da América Latina: Pereira (1994), Santiago do Chile (1995), La Rábida (1996), Bogotá (1998), Toluca (1999), Rosário (2001), Camagüey (2002), Rio de Janeiro (2004), Bahía Blanca (2006), Querétaro (2008), Mendoza (2010), Belo Horizonte (2012), Salvador (2014), Monterrey (2016), Santiago do Chile (2018), Blumenau (2020), Toluca (2022) e Bahía Blanca (2024).Ao longo desta jornada, a agenda da RII envolveu-se com os principais processos do capitalismo global contemporâneo. Atualmente, esses processos se manifestam na intensificação de conflitos geopolíticos, no aumento das desigualdades sociais e territoriais, nas dinâmicas migratórias em larga escala e nas transformações decorrentes do desenvolvimento científico e tecnológico.A isso se somam fenômenos como as mudanças climáticas, a crescente insegurança no ambiente digital, o avanço de projetos políticos autoritários e a reconfiguração das relações internacionais, marcada, entre outros fatores, pela presença da China na América Latina. Dando continuidade a essa trajetória, o XIX Seminário RII se realiza sob o tema “Transformações produtivas e tensões geopolíticas: desafios para os povos ibero-americanos”, na Universidade Federal do Paraná, em Curitiba, Brasil, de 7 a 9 de outubro de 2026.Objetivo do SeminárioO XIX Seminário da RII visa promover uma análise crítica e interdisciplinar das transformações produtivas contemporâneas e das tensões geopolíticas, considerando suas múltiplas escalas e expressões territoriais nos países ibero-americanos.No contexto atual, caracterizado pela reconfiguração da ordem global, pelo aumento das desigualdades, pela crise climática e pela emergência de novos atores no cenário internacional, torna-se essencial refletir sobre os desafios enfrentados pelos territórios ibero-americanos, bem como sobre possíveis alternativas para o desenvolvimento, a governança e a integração regional.Nesse contexto, o seminário busca fomentar discussões sobre economia, geopolítica, meio ambiente, dinâmicas urbano-regionais, movimentos sociais e políticas públicas, incentivando o diálogo interdisciplinar e a diversidade de abordagens teóricas e metodológicas. Os painéis temáticos abordam esses processos sob diferentes perspectivas, permitindo uma abordagem abrangente dos problemas contemporâneos.Grupos temáticos1. Dimensões multiescalares das transformações geopolíticas e geoeconômicas Este grupo aborda as recentes transformações da ordem geopolítica e geoeconômica global, considerando suas implicações em diferentes escalas territoriais e seu impacto nos países ibero-americanos.1.1 Transformações da ordem mundial e reconfiguração geoeconômica: perspectivas históricas e contemporâneas.1.2 Problemas estruturais da América Latina: dependência, integração regional e disputas territoriais.1.3 Geopolítica das mudanças climáticas e da transição energética: recursos naturais, biodiversidade, energia e territórios estratégicos (a Amazônia, o lítio, entre outros).1.4 Relações internacionais e novas configurações de poder: BRICS, expansão asiática e laços entre a China e a América Latina.2. Processos globais e transformações produtivas contemporâneas Este grupo examina as mudanças nos sistemas de produção no contexto da globalização contemporânea, com especial atenção às inovações tecnológicas, à dinâmica territorial e às estratégias organizacionais emergentes.2.1 Inovação tecnológica e transformação produtiva: inteligência artificial, tecnologias da Indústria 4.0, 5G e Internet das Coisas.2.2 Cadeias globais de valor, regulação e assimetrias tecnológicas entre territórios.2.3 Estratégias produtivas e organizacionais em setores como agricultura e indústria.2.4 Financeirização da produção e suas implicações territoriais.2.5 Experiências alternativas: tecnologias sociais, economias solidárias e práticas contra-hegemônicas.3. Crise climática e conflitos socioambientais Este grupo concentra-se nas inter-relações entre a crise climática, os conflitos socioambientais e as transformações territoriais, considerando os seus efeitos nas condições de vida e na dinâmica social.3.1 Impactos socioambientais da produção global e desigualdades territoriais.3.2 Conflitos socioambientais, vulnerabilidade territorial e deslocamentos/migrações ambientais.3.3 Mercantilização da natureza: uso da terra, extrativismo e degradação ambiental.3.4 Políticas de transição energética e descarbonização.3.5 Cidadania ambiental, participação social e governança de recursos.4. Processos urbano-regionais contemporâneos e desigualdades socioespaciais Este grupo analisa as transformações urbano-regionais no contexto contemporâneo, atentando para as desigualdades socioespaciais, os processos de reconfiguração territorial e o papel da tecnologia na organização do espaço.4.1 Transformações urbanas e regionais: centralidades, fragmentação e segregação territorial.4.2 Financeirização do desenvolvimento urbano e mercantilização do espaço.4.3 Desigualdades socioespaciais: migração, exclusão e acesso à infraestrutura e aos serviços urbanos.4.4 Cidades digitais e inteligentes: implicações para o planejamento e a gestão urbana.4.5 Gentrificação, deslocamento e políticas urbanas.5. Políticas públicas e planejamento territorial nos países ibero-americanos Este grupo examina o papel das políticas públicas e do planejamento territorial na gestão dos desafios contemporâneos, considerando diferentes níveis de governo e atores sociais.5.1 Planejamento territorial: abordagens, instrumentos e desafios na América Latina.5.2 Governança multinível e a coordenação de políticas setoriais.5.3 Participação social, movimentos sociais e processos de defesa pública.5.4 Políticas habitacionais, acesso à terra e o direito à cidade.5.5 Qualidade de vida, serviços urbanos e desigualdades territoriais.5.6 Políticas setoriais: emprego, saúde, alimentação e sustentabilidade.Considerações para o envio de resumos Os resumos serão submetidos através da plataforma EasyChair por meio deste link: https://easychair.org/cfp/19thSeminarioRII. Para obter mais detalhes, consulte as Diretrizes para Submissão de Resumos.Autoria e responsabilidades No caso de propostas com mais de um autor, a pessoa que submeter o resumo através da plataforma EasyChair será responsável por registrar corretamente as informações completas de todos os coautores.Cada pessoa poderá submeter, no máximo, dois resumos, seja como autor(a) ou coautor(a).Observe que, após o envio da proposta, não será possível adicionar ou remover nomes de autores, nem modificar a ordem dos mesmos. Caso a proposta seja aceita, a ordem e o formato dos nomes serão os que constarão no programa do seminário, nos anais e nos respectivos certificados.No caso de propostas com mais de três autores, o tipo de contribuição de cada autor deverá ser especificado de acordo com a Taxonomia CRediT.Recomenda-se revisar cuidadosamente os critérios de autoria antes da submissão. Para isso, serão utilizadas como referência as recomendações do Committee on Publication Ethics (COPE).Critérios de avaliação de resumos As propostas de resumo serão avaliadas por meio de um processo de revisão por pares simples-cego, no qual os revisores têm acesso às informações de autoria, enquanto a identidade dos revisores não é revelada aos candidatos. O processo inclui duas rodadas de avaliação para garantir uma avaliação mais robusta e consistente das propostas.O processo de avaliação considerará os seguintes critérios: relevância, valor para a comunidade acadêmica, qualidade metodológica e diversidade. Esses critérios orientam uma avaliação abrangente das propostas e visam garantir um programa acadêmico rigoroso, relevante e inclusivo.Para promover a equidade e a diversidade no processo de seleção, os revisores são incentivados a exercer um julgamento crítico consciente, considerando possíveis vieses e concentrando sua avaliação na qualidade, contribuição e relevância das propostas.Publicação e repositórioOs resumos aceitos serão integrados aos Anais do Seminário publicados através do Repositório da RII no Zenodo.Esta integração visa fortalecer a visibilidade, a acessibilidade e a preservação da produção acadêmica gerada no seminário. O depósito no Zenodo inclui a atribuição de um identificador persistente (DOI), que promove a interoperabilidade, a rastreabilidade e a citação adequada dos materiais.A publicação nos anais não impede a publicação posterior de versões ampliadas ou revisadas em periódicos acadêmicos ou outros meios de comunicação, desde que essas versões incorporem desenvolvimentos substanciais e reconheçam a versão previamente divulgada no âmbito do Seminário.Além disso, as contribuições podem ser consideradas para inclusão em processos editoriais proomovidos pela própria RII, incluindo a possível criação de dossiês temáticos ou volumes editados, de acordo com critérios acadêmicos e editoriais definidos.Datas importantesTaxas de inscrição

postings.conferenceName: ChinaSoft 2026-Intelligent industrial software engineering: large model-driven development, assurance and governance
postings.conferenceText: Topics: development assurance governanceAs the capabilities of large models rapidly evolve from mere "content generation" to the "execution of software engineering tasks," they are becoming a crucial technological foundation for intelligent software development, quality assurance, and engineering governance. This shift propels software engineering beyond simple tool-assisted workflows toward model-enhanced processes, human-AI collaboration, and full-lifecycle intelligence. Addressing the realities of industrial software—characterized by complex requirements, diverse application scenarios, high system coupling, and stringent reliability and safety standards—large models must not only boost engineering efficiency in phases such as requirements analysis, architectural design, code generation, and documentation, but also enhance software quality and operational trustworthiness in areas like test generation, defect localization, reliability analysis, runtime monitoring, and fault diagnosis. Concurrently, as large models become deeply embedded in industrial software engineering workflows, issues such as model hallucinations, code security, intellectual property rights, version evolution, compliance auditing, liability tracing, and security governance are becoming increasingly prominent. Conducting research into key technologies—including large-model-driven software development, quality assurance, and engineering governance—holds significant academic and practical value for fostering the deep integration of AI4SE and SE4AI, establishing a methodology system for intelligent industrial software engineering, and supporting the high-quality development of industrial software.Submission Guidelines1. Manuscript Types(1) Original research papers(2) High-quality review papers(3) System and tool papers(4) Industrial software practice papers2. Submission Requirements(1) Submissions must be made via the unified EasyChair portal found on the ChinaSoft 2026 "Call for Papers" webpage. Please ensure you select the track titled "Intelligent Industrial Software Engineering: Large Model-Driven Development, Assurance, and Governance." Formatting guidelines can be found at: http://cjc.ict.ac.cn/wltg/zgjz.htm.(2) Submissions must represent the authors' own research findings; data must be authentic, reliable, and previously unpublished. Citations must be properly attributed, and authorship must be undisputed. Papers should present a comprehensive account of research with innovative academic insights that contribute positively to the field.(3) Papers must be well-written and readable, with clear expression and no logical or grammatical errors; the content should be easily accessible and understandable to reviewers.3. Important Dates(1) Phase 1: ChinaSoft 2026 Conference SubmissionSubmission deadline: September 1, 2026 (select this track during submission).Notification of review results: September 15, 2026.Deadline for returning revised manuscripts: October 15, 2026 (the track committee will review the revisions).(2) Phase 2: Conference Presentation and Final Revision SubmissionChinaSoft 2026 Conference: November 2026, Tianjin. Note: For accepted papers, at least one author must present the paper in person at the conference and answer questions from reviewers and the audience; otherwise, the paper will be withdrawn.Final revision submission deadline: Within one week after the oral presentation at the November conference; revisions should incorporate feedback received from the audience and reviewers during the presentation. (3) Phase 3: Selection for Journal ReviewNotification of selection: December 15, 2026. The track's review panel will evaluate submissions and notify the authors of selected conference papers; *Chinese Journal of Computers* will then conduct an internal review to determine whether to publish them.Topic list1. Development: Large Model-Driven Industrial Software Development Methods(1) Large model-based methods for industrial software requirements analysis: Focusing on knowledge such as industrial protocols, equipment manuals, control logic, production workflows, interface specifications, and industry standards, research is conducted on requirements extraction, understanding, specification generation, defect detection, consistency checking, and traceability.(2) Intelligent development technologies for industrial software code generation and program understanding: Targeting objects such as industrial control logic, embedded programs, industrial service interfaces, automation scripts, and platform components, research focuses on code generation, completion, summarization, translation, program understanding, API recommendation, and automated repair.(3) Technologies for the architectural design and evolution of complex industrial software systems: Targeting complex software such as industrial control systems, Industrial Internet platforms, Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), and equipment O&M systems, research covers architectural modeling, module partitioning, interface design, architecture recommendation, technical debt identification, architecture evaluation, and evolution methods.2. Assurance: Large Model-Assisted Industrial Software Quality Assurance Methods(4) Software test generation and verification technologies for high-reliability industrial software: Research focuses on methods such as test case generation, test assertion generation, test script maintenance, regression testing, fuzz testing, simulation testing, digital twin testing, hardware-in-the-loop testing, scenario-based testing, and formal verification.(5) Large model-based methods for industrial software defect detection, localization, and repair: Integrating code, logs, call chains, alarm records, equipment status, execution traces, and failure cases, research addresses defect detection, vulnerability identification, defect localization, root cause analysis, fault diagnosis, patch generation, and repair verification.(6) Intelligent technologies for industrial software reliability analysis and operational assurance: Addressing requirements such as real-time performance, high reliability, security, availability, and maintainability, research focuses on reliability modeling, reliability prediction, anomaly detection, fault prediction, operational monitoring, intelligent O&M, and risk assessment methods.3.Governance: Software engineering governance methods for large model applications(7) Compliance and trustworthiness assessment technologies for large models in industrial software engineering: Researching methods for verifying correctness, checking consistency, detecting hallucinations, ensuring license compliance and intellectual property protection, and conducting model audits and liability tracing regarding large-model-generated code, documentation, test cases, patches, and analysis reports.(8) Software engineering governance technologies for large model version evolution: Researching continuous governance methods for large models in industrial software engineering, addressing issues such as version management, capability drift detection, model degradation analysis, change impact assessment, the evolution of prompts and toolchains, reproducibility of generated results, and lifecycle management.(9) Security governance and risk protection technologies for large models in industrial software engineering: Researching methods for prompt injection protection, data leakage detection, code security review, tool invocation oversight, security validation of generated results, software supply chain security, industrial control security, and end-to-end traceability auditing.CommitteeGuest EditorJin Liu (Wuhan University)Junping Wang (Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences)Xinyu Wang (Zhejiang University)Wei Dong (National University of Defense Technology)Bo Huang (Shanghai University of Engineering Science)SiteThe meeting will be held in Tianjin.ContactFor all questions regarding submission, please send an email to huangbosues@sues.edu.cn

postings.conferenceName: 27th Rapid Product Development Association of South Africa Conference, joined by the Advanced Materials Initiative
postings.conferenceText: Topics: additive manufacturing materials engineering product design and development am post processing and qualificationFollowing the success of the 2025 RAPDASA Conference, joined by RobMech, PRASA and AMI, hosted at the CSIR International Convention Centre in Pretoria, South Africa on 27 to 30 October 2025, we are pleased to announce the Call for Abstracts for the 2026 RAPDASA-AMI international conference to be held on 27 – 30 October 2026. The conference venue will be Protea Hotel Polokwane Ranch Resort near Polokwane in the Limpopo province of South Africa. RAPDASA will again be joined by the South African Advanced Materials Initiative (AMI). This conference will bring together experts from industry, research and development (R&D)institutions, academia and students, in additive manufacturing, materials engineering, rapid product development and advanced manufacturing to present their research, development and implementation and to network to expand the fraternity that has been built by the previous conferences. The theme of the 2026 conference is: From Prototype to Production: Translating Research into Reality Opportunities will be offered for local and international participants from industry, R&D institutions, academia and government, to connect and collaborate to grow the next generation of product development and advanced manufacturing enterprises in Africa and globally by implementation of R&D. Conference papers on the following topics are welcomed: Product Design and Development Materials Selection for Design Additive Manufacturing Rapid Prototyping Advanced Manufacturing Computer-aided Design Reverse Engineering Design, Simulation and Modelling Computational Analytics Process Modelling Structural Analysis Materials Engineering Materials Processing Tooling Design and Development Artificial Intelligence Machine Learning End-user Applications and Systems Knowledge Based Systems Information Technology Applied to Manufacturing Robotics and Automation Management of Research and Technology Education and Training Agile Manufacturing Renewable Energy Applications Who should attend? The Organizing Committee invites product designers, engineers, production staff, technical directors and managers from industry involved in design, development and manufacturing of products and components to submit an abstract and present their work or simply attend the conference. In addition, participants from international product development and materials engineering communities, academia and R&D institutions are invited to participate in the conference through submission of full papers. Additive manufacturing, rapid product development, digitalisation and automation have become crucially important in the international advanced manufacturing industry. Ample opportunities will be available to meet with experts in the field. Important dates deadlines • First announcement and call for abstracts for 2026 conference: 15 December 2025 • Extended deadline for submission of abstracts: 7 April 2026 • Notification of acceptance of abstracts: 30 March to 15 April 2026 • Deadline for submission of full papers: 8 June 2026 • Feedback on paper reviews: 3 August 2026 • Submission deadline for poster text: 31 August 2026 • Submission deadline for final revised papers: 31 August 2026 • Submission deadline for poster designs: 28 September 2026 Please see the Conference abstract & paper submission for instructions on how to submit an abstract to the conference. Publication of papers Abstracts must first be accepted before submission of a full paper can proceed. All papers submitted for the conference will be subjected to a double-blind peer review process, which will be led by the Technical Committee. Papers accepted after peer review will be published in the conference proceedings in MATEC Web of Conferences. Selected papers that comply with the scope of the journal and are of high quality, will be submitted for publication in the ISI accredited The South African Journal of Industrial Engineering (SAJIE). Industry presentations As an alternative to the above publication of peer-reviewed papers, industry participants can present their applied research in a non-peer-reviewed format. Only an abstract of 300 words in length must be submitted for such industry presentations. Industry presentations will not be included in the conference proceedings. The extended deadline for industry abstracts is 7 April 2026 Companies or organisations that wish to be a sponsor of the conference proceedings may contact Rynette Coetzer at info@rapdasa.org

postings.conferenceText: Topics: ai agent learning society adaptive learning&educational equity smart learning ecosystem2026年数字终身学习国际会议（2026 DTALL）定于2026年10月16日至17日在中国上海举行。2026年数字终身学习国际会议（2026 DTALL）计划于2026年10月16日至17日在中国上海举行。本次会议将由上海开放大学（SOU）、联合国教科文组织终身学习研究所（UIL）和联合国教科文组织教育信息技术研究所（UNESCO IITE）联合主办。会议期间，举办了题为“人工智能赋能智能学习生态系统：综合发展”的特别学术环节。本场次将聚焦人工智能深度融入智能学习生态系统，探讨如何将技术、以人为本的原则和社会价值观在各年龄段学习场景中协调一致。该会议与构建终身学习社会的全球目标相契合，旨在推动包容、公平和可持续的教育技术生态系统。该会议将为研究人员、学者、行业从业者、全球数字终身学习网络成员及其他利益相关者提供一个顶级的国际平台，分享最新的研究成果和创新实践。为了促进全球知识交流并展示典范实践，我们诚挚邀请全球学者和从业者提交原创研究论文和案例研究。技术委员会主办机构：上海开放大学联合国教科文组织教育信息技术研究所联合组织者：全球数字终身学习网络秘书处上海开放远程教育工程研究中心上海教育技术协会人工智能专业委员会上海智慧城市发展院提交要求所有论文必须是原创的，且不得同时向其他期刊或会议提交。欢迎关注以下论文类别。提交类型： 摘要、完整研究论文和海报论文。语言： 摘要、海报论文和完整论文均必须以英语提交。内容： 提交内容可能涵盖理论研究、技术创新、模型设计、教育评估、学习系统开发及相关主题。手稿应呈现清晰的论据、可靠的数据、简洁的写作以及设计良好的图表和表格。长度要求：摘要应为150-250字，包含标题、摘要和关键词。海报论文应约2页，包括图表、参考文献和附录。完整论文应至少8页，总页数不超过10页，包括图表、参考文献和附录。模板： 将提供Word和LaTeX模板。发表与期刊推荐发表与期刊推荐发表与期刊推荐经过同行评审批准的高质量论文和案例研究将被纳入Springer出版的编辑卷中。尚未正式发表的手稿作者将被会议组织者邀请提交其全篇文章。此外，未发表的论文将有资格被推荐至相关同行评审学术期刊，包括《远程教育》（Q1国际期刊）、《国际远程教育技术杂志》（IJDET）（收录于SCOPUS、EI Compendex和ESCI，Q1层）以及《亚洲开放大学协会期刊》（AAOUJ）（收录于Scopus）。对于所有期刊推荐路径，会议选拔或推荐并不构成接受或保证发表。所有推荐作者必须通过相关期刊的常规投稿系统提交稿件，所有稿件将经过期刊标准的独立同行评审和编辑评估流程。经过评估，部分案例提交将纳入会议案例集，并有助于2026年国际数字终身学习会议的主要成果。诚挚邀请全球的研究人员、一线教育者和行业从业者投稿稿件。 主题终身学习和学习社会中的人工智能驱动创新以人为本、包容且可持续的教育人工智能由人工智能支持的个性化和自适应学习智能学习生态系统中的治理、质量保证与伦理问题人工智能驱动智能学习生态系统的创新实践与案例研究人工智能在教育中使用中的公平性：学习者、教师、学校与系统人工智能代理用于增强智能学习生态系统中的教学、学习和学习者支持技术委员会Chairs of the Technical Committee:Xiao Jun, Research Fellow, Shanghai Open University;
